name: DuoStatusBar
author: Muzi
description:
Merges the iPhone status bar's battery, Wi-Fi and cellular signal icons into a single circular widget in the style of the iPhone Duo outer display.

v20 changes:
- Switched to STUIStatusBar-native hook (port from 34306/DuoBar) so the indicator actually lives inside the system status bar rather than being a separate overlay window. Result: no more flash on Control Center / lock screen.
- Fixed the smart-invert colour bug. The icon now follows STUIStatusBar's foregroundColor directly, so it auto-inverts against any wallpaper like the rest of the status bar — works in colour mode too, not just b/w.

Settings: position offsets, icon size, ring width, per-element HEX colours, debug log.
changelog:
v1.1.0 (2026-09-14)
- STUIStatusBar-native hook (port from 34306/DuoBar): duo view now lives inside the system status bar instead of being an overlay UIWindow.
- Smart-invert fix: tint follows STUIStatusBar.foregroundColor directly, replacing the fragile 'sample wallpaper pixel, lum > 0.55 → black/white' binarisation that broke colour tinting.
- Airplane-mode indicator hook: now renders the airplane glyph when toggled.
- Deprecated DUOStatusBarOverlay class (kept only for ABI).

v1.0.0
- Initial release (UIWindow overlay).
